none: PAS NLM-9B9E3A: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), possibly irregular copy of a Constantinopolis commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted bust left, trident over shoulder to right. Obverse inscription: [CONSTANTINOPOLIS]. Reverse description: Victory with shield to right [on prow]. Diameter: 12mm, Weight: 1.10gms, die axis: 12
